code.description: Machine-readable error code (e.g. broker_disconnected). For broker.resolve_instrument also the instrument-resolution codes: instrument_unresolvable, instrument_mismatch, instrument_delisted, unsupported (same meaning as in deal.rejected.code).

command_type.description: The broker.* command that failed (e.g. broker.get_accounts).

title: payload: broker.error
description: NACK for any broker.* command (get_accounts/get_orders/resolve_instrument). Correlated to the request via correlation_id.
